record.field: Privilege: a Telegram customer is answered in their live chat session

Held by the updates of a bot's customers and by what the session sends them back: read and keep the Telegram sessions (live chat channels of a Telegram chat), post and edit their comments, follow their chatbot's questions and answers, and read who answered them. A customer is no Odoo user and no member the session's own rules know; the session itself opens on im_livechat's privilege to open one, as the web route opens a visitor's.
